arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-21' AND date < '2019-10-28'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in the Monday-to-Sunday week before the final partial week of the data, which is 21 to 27 October 2019.
assumptions: Relative dates resolve against the last day of the data, 2019-10-31 (a Thursday). 'Last week' is taken as the most recent complete Monday-to-Sunday week: 2019-10-21 to 2019-10-27.
The count includes all transactions, labelled or not, since the question asks about transactions rather than fraud.
